package.name: fc01_mission
package.description: Flight guidance for the fc01 impact drone: consumes /fc01/vision/target_relative (or VisionState) and the platform state, runs the takeoff / cruise / strike / push / retreat / hold mission, and publishes jikl_fc01_system/VelocityCommand on /visioncontrol. Vision is provided by the bringup: fc01_bringup on the aircraft, fc01_vision_sim in simulation.
